[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Randall Jaggert''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] tasked with the construction of the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]] in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]] not long after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
